text: Showa Sangyo Co., Ltd.'s major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 are ITOCHU Corporation (7.0%), The Master Trust Bank of Japan (Trust Account, 6.4%) and Mitsui & Co., Ltd. (4.7%), followed by its business-partner shareholding association, Yuasa Funashoku, Cargill Japan, its employee shareholding association, Chiba Bank, a Mizuho retirement-benefit trust and Marubeni, all under 5%.
short: Showa Sangyo's top holders as of 31 March 2026: ITOCHU 7.0%, Master Trust 6.4%, Mitsui & Co. 4.7%.
